title: feat(core): merge consecutive private messages
implement: Implement meaningful tests using the existing core fakes and Vitest fake timers. Preserve LLM call logging and redelivery deduplication. Create one batcher per process, reset its 2.5-second timer on each new message, remove a batch before awaiting its flush, catch flush errors, and keep different chats independent. Join text in arrival order with newlines; non-text-only batches use the existing decline without calling the model. Keep the "tanomu is listening on Feishu" startup line. Cover an incoming message during an in-flight reply, mixed text/non-text batches, timer reset, independent chats, and redelivery.
review: Check timer reset at 2.5 s, chat isolation, removal before asynchronous flush, errors being caught, deduplication before batching, ordered newline joining, non-text-only decline without an LLM call, mixed batches, preserved call logging, thin single-instance wiring, and meaningful tests including messages during an in-flight generation.
acceptance: Stop production, send three rapid Private Conversation messages to a local instance, confirm one ordered merged reply, then restore production.
